speaker: thomas_pope
text: You are out of the Shrew tomorrow. I asked Garnish. He showed me the plot, and your name is not on it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. I am an old Roman today, and I am already done. Tomorrow can be someone else's afternoon.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The bill at the Rose is the first part of Hercules, at two. I am not sending you. I am telling you what is up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I will go over. I should like to see how a giant is done.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: See it, and come back with your own legs. I have no use for a lion's skin at this house.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Tomorrow is the hole in the week. Use it or don't. I have said the bill once.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will use it. Hercules at two. I am not in the Shrew. That is the whole of tomorrow.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then wash the Roman off before you tell anyone you have a plan. You still have the look of a man who died in the fourth act.
